RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the April 15, 2008/Chaitra 26, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
101
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Waiving of loans by banks
†*321. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to non-
repayment, loan amount to the tune of
Rs. 60,000 crores has been waived off by
Government and private banks in the
country during the last five years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount waived off by banks in
the country during 2002-03 to 2006-07,
year-wise; and
(d) the quantum of this waived off amount
which pertains to the corporate sector,
agriculture sector and retail loan sector?
Coal Bed Methane Policy
*322. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) the salient features of the Coal Bed
Methane Policy, 1997;
(b) the details of blocks awarded for the
exploration and production;
(c) the basis of awarding such blocks;
(d) whether the exploration in all the
blocks has been completed;
(e) if so, the details of the blocks,
capacity-wise; and
(f) in how many blocks commercial
production has started and how is it being
utilized?

102
Petronet LNG terminal at Kochi
*323. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether statutory approvals for the
project Petronet LNG terminal at Kochi
have been granted;
(b) the details of the pre-project
activities;
(c) whether the arrangement for gas
supply has been finalized;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether there are any further
formalities to be completed prior to the
commissioning of the project;
(f) if so, the details thereof;
(g) whether there is any time-frame fixed
for the commissioning of the project; and
(h) if so, the details thereof?
Tourism package for Goa
*324. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
give any package to the State Government
of Goa to give a boost to the tourism
industry there;
(b) whether Government proposes to
approve any special project proposed by
the State Government in this regard;
(c) whether the proposed tourism
policy of Government has been finalized;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Percentage of irrigated land
*325. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of irrigated land over
the total area of agricultural land, State-
wise;
(b) the area of land coming under
irrigation during the financial year
2007-08, State-wise; and
(c) the target of irrigation fixed for the
year 2007-08 and the percentage of the
same achieved so far?
Non-availability of institutional
lending sources for farmers
*326. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
around 52 per cent farmers do not have
access to institutional sources like banks
and cooperatives;
(b) if so, whether Government is aware
that most of the farmers take loan from the
moneylenders;
(c) if so, whether  Government proposes
to regulate the banking business being done
by these moneylenders and get them
registered with the Reserve Bank of India
to carry on banking business and also
regulate the interest rates; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Zonal Cultural Centres
*327. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the mandate of Zonal
Cultural Centres;
(b) whether any study has been done
on the performance of such Zonal Cultural
Centres against their mandate;

103
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the details of such study;
(d) whether it is a fact that the Zonal
Cultural Centres are facing resource crunch;
(e) if so, the annual allocation for the
last three years, Centre-wise; and
(f) the details of quarter-wise release of
Plan and Non-Plan funds to each of the
Centre during the financial year 2007-08?
Buddhist tourist circuit
*328. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to link
Buddhist tourist circuit in India with such
foreign centres in Japan, Thailand,
Sri Lanka, etc.; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, inter-alia
indicating such Buddhist hubs in Orissa
that are proposed to be linked with these
countries under the above project?
Difference in inflation rates
*329. SHRI PENUMALLI MADHU:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the reasons for the difference in the
inflation rates between Wholesale Price
Index and Consumer Price Indices; and
(b) what are the steps/changes proposed
to narrow the difference?
Ajay Prasad Committee on air
navigation
*330. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Ajay Prasad Committee on
a master plan on air navigation has recently
given its recommendations to Government;
(b) if so, the details of the
recommendations made by the Committee;
(c) whether air traffic congestion at
major airports is the main factor responsible
for delay in flights;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of the recommendations
of the Ajay Prasad Committee accepted by
Government and to what extent it will help
in smooth functioning of the major airports
of the country?
Indian tourism offices in foreign
countries
*331. SH RIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the countries and
foreign cities where Indian tourism offices
are located;
(b) the details of the expenditure
incurred on these offices during the last
three years, office-wise;
(c) the strategies adopted by these
offices to attract foreign tourists to various
Indian States, particularly Himachal
Pradesh; and
(d) what schemes Government
proposes to formulate to promote medical
tourism and adventure tourism through
these tourism offices?
Identification of farmers for waiving
of loans
†*332. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) by when the farmers eligible for
waiving of loans will be identified under

104
waiving of loans programme for 2007-08
by the Central Government;
(b) by when the farmers' amount of
loans will be deducted after identifying the
farmers eligible for waiving of loans; and
(c) by when the farmers will become
eligible for taking institutional loans again
after waiving of their loans?
Constitution of the Competition
Commission
*333. SHRI HARISH RAW A T:
SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CORPORATE
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Competition
Commission has been fully constituted;
(b) if so, the details of the members
alongwith their academic and professional
background;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether the mandate of the
Competition Commission overlaps with
the terms of reference of various Sector-
specific independent regulators;
(e) what steps have been taken to avoid
such overlapping of mandates; and
(f) the details of linkage between the
independent regulators and the Competition
Commission?
Construction of River Valley Project
†*334. SHRI LAXMINARAY AN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of WA TER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for increase in salinity
of the soil in the regions of river valley
projects constructed under First and
Second Five Year Plans;
(b) the steps being taken to check it;
(c) whether situation will improve with
the implementation of river linking projects;
and
(d) if not, the reasons for not stopping
the work on river linking projects?
Premium received from LIC's foreign
operations
*335. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the first year premium
received from LIC's foreign operations;
(b) whether it is a fact that LIC's foreign
operations are showing a negative growth
for the last few years; and
(c) if so, what steps are being taken to
rectify this trend?
Failure of banking sector to serve the
weaker sections of society
*336. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the banking
sector has failed to meet the targets for
weaker sections of the society;
(b) whether it is also a fact that economic
reforms have reinforced financial exclusion
of landless groups belonging to weaker
sections who would suffer from agrarian
crisis and uprooting as a result of
industrialisation and urbanisation;
(c) if so, whether Government is taking
any action; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

105
Special law for safeguarding interest
of depositors
*337. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
promulgating any special law for making
provisions to safeguard the interest of the
depositors in financial establishments;
(b) whether it is a fact that 14 States
have enacted a special law to safeguard the
interest of the depositors in financial
establishments after due approval of
Government; and
(c) if so, the steps the remaining States
are taking in this respect?
Strategic crude oil reserves
*338. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether construction of strategic
crude oil storages will begin this year as an
insurance against disruptions during wars
and other emergencies;
(b) whether of the three sites selected
to hold 5 million tons, a year's  crude oil
reserves is equivalent to country's 15 days'
requirement;
(c) whether it is proposed to double the
overall strategic reserve capacity to 73.3
million barrels, twice the 15  days' cover
planned currently;
(d) by when, the remaining sites of the
capacity would be considered; and
(e) to what extent this would help the
country in meeting the shortage during the
emergency period?
Air connectivity
†*339. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether all the major cities in the
country have been liked with air services;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the details of the airports in the
country for whose construction, political
organizations and public representatives
have requested during  the last three years
till date; and
(e) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Banking facility for Juhapura area of
Ahmedabad City
*340. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE:: Will the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is  a fact that none of the
banks is coming forward to open a branch
in the Juhapura area of Ahmedabad city,
where a large number of muslims resides;
(b) whether it is also a fact that inspite of
repeated requests by the local residents, that
area is still without a branch of any bank;
(c) it so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any plan to help
the residents of that area; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 9th April, 2008 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 20, 1930 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
